title: AgentTaskResult v1
description: Generic result envelope for any agent-worker bot. Reports the terminal status and where the run's output landed in S3, so the consumer can fetch documents without knowing how a run directory is laid out. envelope.businessKey is echoed verbatim from the request — the worker never synthesises one.

params.description: Echo of the request params, so a result is self-describing in an audit trail without joining back to the request.

status.description: SUCCESS: everything the bot set out to produce exists. PARTIAL: some output produced, some not — the artifacts listed are valid and usable, but the run is incomplete and worth review. FAILED: nothing usable produced.

category.description: Same taxonomy as payroll-submit-result.v1, so existing consumer branching keeps working.

error.description: Required (non-null) whenever status is FAILED. Optional on PARTIAL to explain what is missing.

folder.description: s3:// URI of the run folder, trailing slash included. Null when no artifacts bucket is configured (local dev) or the upload failed — in that case the output exists only on the worker's disk and the run should be treated as unretrievable.

files.description: Every object uploaded for this run, including operational artifacts (manifest.json, report.png, network.har). Documents produced by the bot are under a bot-specific prefix — ccss-sicere-reports writes reports/.

name.description: Path relative to the run folder, e.g. 'reports/PlanillaNeoprocSociedadAnonima082026.pdf'.

bytes.description: Object size; -1 when it could not be read.
